idea-plugin.name: Service Launcher
idea-plugin.description:
Service Launcher gives multi-service projects a focused control panel inside Rider. Arrange services in groups, select the ones needed for the current task, and start or debug them together.

Launcher entries are created explicitly and remain independent from Rider run configurations. Link them when they are ready to run while Rider stays responsible for execution, debugging, consoles, environment variables, and before-launch tasks.

The goal is an organized view over a development environment, not a competing process or configuration system.

Source code: Soloplan/rider-service-launcher
